replacements.new: $('viewFile').onchange=async()=>{const f=$('viewFile').files[0];if(!f)return;const request=++reviewRead,snapshot=JSON.stringify(review());const ownsReview=()=>request===reviewRead&&snapshot===JSON.stringify(review());try{if(f.size>1000000)throw Error('Review file exceeds 1 MB');const contents=await f.text();if(!ownsReview()){if(request===reviewRead)signal('The review changed while the file was loading. Reopen the file when you are ready to replace the current view.');return;}const v=JSON.parse(contents),s=D.studies.find(s=>s.id===v.study_id);if(v.schema!=='upstate.station-review-view/v1'||!s||s.edition_id!==v.edition_id)throw Error('Review file does not match a retained native edition');renderStudy(s.id);selected=s.stations.some(s=>s.station_id===v.selected_station_id)?v.selected_station_id:'';source=[...$('sourceFilter').options].some(o=>o.value===v.source_id)?v.source_id:'';query=typeof v.row_search==='string'?v.row_search:'';stationQuery=typeof v.station_search==='string'?v.station_search:'';$('rowSearch').value=query;$('stationSearch').value=stationQuery;$('sourceFilter').value=source;$('notes').value=typeof v.notes==='string'?v.notes:'';if(Array.isArray(v.map_view)&&v.map_view.length===4&&v.map_view.every(Number.isFinite)&&v.map_view[2]>0&&v.map_view[3]>0)view=v.map_view;lastFitMode=null;renderStations();updateView();renderRecords();signal('Saved review view reopened against the same native edition.');}catch(e){if(ownsReview())signal('Could not reopen review: '+e.message);}finally{if(request===reviewRead)$('viewFile').value='';}};
